text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated connection reset rates observed from edge-proxy cluster in us-east-3. Symptoms: intermittent 502s for streaming responses and aborted websocket upgrades. Detect window: 04:08 UTC. Initial impact estimate: ~12% of streaming traffic. Customers: few high-throughput customers experiencing failures. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/RE-2026-03-edgeproxy-reset

jessica (on-call): I'm investigating now. First-priority: reduce customer impact. Rolling back the nginx keepalive change that went out in the 04:00 deploy. @maya can you confirm deploy artifact?

maya: Confirmed — a config tweak set keepalive_timeout=5s in the autoscaling probe job at 04:02 UTC. That change can cause upstream resets under high connection churn. Starting hotfix roll to restore to 75s on all us-east-3 proxy nodes.

rick: Re-routing new sessions away from us-east-3 at the global LB level to us-east-1 and us-west-2 now (gradual 70% cutover). Will monitor error rate.

incident-bot: UPDATE: Traffic reroute in progress — 70% -> us-east-1, 30% remaining on us-east-3 for validation. Current 502 rate dropped from ~12% -> ~1.2% in the last 60s.

tom (support): Notifying affected customers (ids: C-1123, C-2244) with temporary mitigation notes. Sending status template now. @alina please coordinate escalation if they ask for whitelisting.

alina (cs): Acknowledged. Reached out to the two contacts, provided ETA ~15-20m for full mitigation and link to status page. Will keep them updated.

sre-lead: Quick sanity check logs pasted below (truncated):
```
[04:05:12] proxy-23 us-east-3 upstream reset: connection reset by peer, keepalive_closed
[04:06:43] proxy-18 us-east-3 upstream reset: premature EOF on upgrade
[04:07:55] proxy-21 us-east-3 accepted new conn, immediate RST after 2s
```

maya: Hotfix rollout to restore keepalive_timeout=75s completed to 100% of us-east-3 at 04:21 UTC. Canary checks passed.

rick: Removing the remaining 30% traffic from us-east-3 now. All traffic back to normal routing.

incident-bot: MITIGATION: Configuration rollback applied and global routing restored. Observed 502s reduced to baseline (<0.2%) across regions over the last 10m. No data loss indicated.

jessica (on-call): Declaring incident: mitigated at 04:31 UTC. We'll keep monitoring for 60m. Creating follow-up action items: 1) Revert config change from autoscaling job and add a pre-deploy integration test for proxy keepalives. 2) Update runbooks for rapid LB rerouting. 3) Postmortem doc + timeline.

tom (support): Closing customer-facing ticket threads with notes and link to status update.

incident-bot: RESOURCES: Public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/RE-2026-03-edgeproxy-reset | Internal postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/RE-2026-03-edgeproxy-reset-draft (will update with timeline).

alina (cs): Thanks team — I'll follow up with customers once the postmortem is available.

sre-lead: Postmortem owners: jessica + maya. Please sync and post draft by EOD.

jessica (on-call): Will do. Thanks everyone for quick responses. :heart:
